title: Fourier formula for variance
statement: For every $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, its variance under the uniform measure on the Boolean cube is the sum of the squared Fourier–Walsh coefficients over all nonempty subsets of coordinates: $\operatorname{Var}(f)=\sum_{\varnothing\ne S\subseteq[n]}\widehat f(S)^2$.
replaced: For every $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$, uniform variance satisfies $\operatorname{Var}(f)=\sum_{\varnothing\ne S\subseteq[n]}\widehat f(S)^2$.
